title: DC US Attorney Jeanine Pirro Announces Arrests in Massive $700M Chinese Crypto Fraud Scheme
description:
DC US Attorney Jeanine Pirro announced charges Thursday against two Chinese nationals who ran a "scam compound in Burma" that bilked Americans out of their life savings. The "Chinese bosses" posed as US banks, the NYPD and other entities to steal from Americans as part of a "coordinated" cybercrime and cryptocurrency fraud campaign, Pirro said. The Shanda Compound they two ran in Burma trafficked, enslaved, tortured and beat thousands who had expected to receive jobs there, in perpetuation of the fraud involving crypto, which is sometimes known as "pig butchering." The DC US attorney noted that at least $700 million has been "restrained" and more than 500 fake websites perpetuating the scheme have been taken down, as part of the investigation that resulted in the indictments against Huang Xingshan and Jiang Wen Jie.

asr.full_text: Today we announce significant milestones in that fight. We have charged Chinese bosses who ran a scam compound in Burma, where thousands were trafficked, enslaved, beaten and then forced to steal from Americans for years. We have seized also a Telegram channel, and that channel was luring workers into a forced compound in Cambodia. taken down more than 500 websites. They were used to steal Americans' life savings. My office is going to continue to work to identify the funds stolen. We have also restrained more than $700 million in cryptocurrency from U.S. victims of fraud. The administration of President Trump is lockstep in combatting these scams and we are just getting started. I am joined today by my colleagues in the criminal Division of the Department of Justice, the FBI, the United States Secret Service, all founding partners in our scam center strike force. In addition, we're joined by interagency partners from the Department of Treasury, as well as the Department of State, who are bringing their special resources to bear on this problem. And they're going to announce in a couple of minutes their own actions as they relate to this particular issue. But first I want to take you into the investigation. It is November of 2025. We deploy the FBI to Thailand following the takedown of the notorious Chinese-run scam center known as the Shunda Compound in Burma. Together with Thai authorities, reams of evidence were reviewed. More than 8,000 phones and 1500 computers were seized which established the hierarchical structure of these Chinese bosses, running the compound that is targeting our American persons. That evidence together with reports from victims here in the United States and information from individuals, led us to charging two Chinese defendants who were managers of the compound. It is significant that when the Shunda Burma compound was taken down, several of the Chinese national organized crime leaders immediately fled to Cambodia in an attempt to set up a new compound in Cambodia, showing how intertwined Burma and Cambodia are in these illegal operations targeting us. Now, the two Chinese nationals over here who ran the slave labor scam factory in Burma where they trafficked and tortured people if they didn't deliver on fake cryptocurrency investments to steal Americans' life savings are Wong-Shing Shown and Jiang Wengi. We look forward to prosecuting them in the United States.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it reports a Justice Department announcement about arrests and charges in a cryptocurrency fraud case, attributing the alleged schemes to compound operators rather than presenting an investment offer or solicitation of its own. The reported Telegram channel is part of the investigation, and the described material does not direct viewers to join it, pay money, provide credentials, or participate in the scheme. The New York Post end card is ordinary publisher branding.
